name: Obsidian Vault
description: Read and write your local Obsidian vaults directly in Cindy—no open Obsidian app or API key needed. Search and cite notes, explore links, update Daily Notes, save conversations, and edit Canvas boards.
whenToUse: Use when the user wants to browse folders, search, read, create, edit, replace text in, or move local Obsidian notes to trash, manage tags or frontmatter properties, read or update Daily Notes, analyze wikilinks/backlinks/orphans, edit Canvas boards, or open the Obsidian workbench or desktop app.

vault_status.description: Inspect registered local Obsidian vaults, write policies (read-only/allowed folders), Obsidian CLI status, and active vault summary (note/link/task counts, top tag overview, daily/inbox folders, recent notes). In a partner conversation it also returns that partner's own folder (summary.defaultFolder). Call first for vault discovery; use list_tags for the full vault tag list.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path; defaults to the active vault.

/properties/refresh.description: Set true to force rescanning the disk index.

list_files.description: List subfolders and files inside a registered vault by folder, depth, and optional file extension (such as md, canvas, png). Reads directory metadata only; use search_notes to search Markdown notes by keywords, tags, or properties.

/properties/folder.description: Vault-relative folder path; omit or pass empty string to start at the vault root.

/properties/depth.description: Traversal depth (1–10). 1 lists direct children only.

/properties/extension.description: Optional file extension filter such as md, .canvas, or png. Directories are always included.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

search_notes.description: Search Markdown notes by keywords, folder, tag, or YAML frontmatter property with relevance ranking, cursor pagination, and body match locations. Use list_files for folder trees or non-Markdown files.

/properties/query.description: Space-separated keywords matched across title, aliases, tags, headings, and body.

/properties/folder.description: Optional subfolder prefix to restrict search.

/properties/tag.description: Optional tag filter (without leading #; matches nested subtags).

/properties/propertyKey.description: Optional YAML frontmatter property key to filter by.

/properties/propertyValue.description: Optional substring required inside the frontmatter property value.

/properties/cursor.description: Pass nextCursor unchanged to fetch the next page with identical query and page size.

/properties/maxMatchesPerNote.description: Maximum body match positions per note (1–20, default 8).

/properties/refresh.description: Force refresh the cached index before searching.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

list_tags.description: List vault-wide tags (combining YAML frontmatter and inline #tags) ranked by usage count with sample notes, optionally filtered by tag prefix. Use manage_tags to edit frontmatter tags on a single note.

/properties/prefix.description: Optional tag or nested prefix filter (without leading #; e.g. project matches project and project/release).

/properties/limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return (1–200, default 50).

/properties/refresh.description: Force refresh the cached index before counting.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

read_note.description: Read a Markdown note in full, by heading/headingPath, or by ^block ID, along with frontmatter, tags, full heading paths, tasks, and direct outlinks/backlinks. Use graph_links for unlinked mentions, 2-hop neighbors, or vault hubs/orphans; use daily_note for Daily Notes.

/properties/path.description: Exact vault-relative .md path (no fuzzy guessing); use title if exact path is unknown.

/properties/heading.description: Optional Markdown heading to read only that section. Mutually exclusive with headingPath and blockId.

/properties/headingPath.description: Optional full heading path such as ["Project A", "Summary"] to disambiguate duplicate headings. Mutually exclusive with heading and blockId.

/properties/blockId.description: Optional Obsidian block ID such as ^meeting-summary. Mutually exclusive with heading and headingPath.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

write_note.description: Create a note or perform structured edits: overwrite, append/prepend, heading or ^block edits, and non-tag YAML frontmatter updates. In a partner conversation, a new note with no folder (or in the inbox) goes into that partner's own folder; the result returns the actual path. Use replace_in_note for literal text replacement, manage_tags for existing note tags, delete_note to move to trash, and daily_note for Daily Notes. Overwriting an existing note requires confirmation.

/properties/mode.description: Write mode (default create): create, overwrite (confirmation required), append/prepend, append-heading/prepend-heading/replace-section (with heading or headingPath), append-block/prepend-block/replace-block (with blockId), or update-frontmatter (non-tag properties).

/properties/heading.description: Target heading for heading write modes (creates a new ## heading if missing). Use either heading or headingPath; mutually exclusive with blockId.

/properties/headingPath.description: Full heading path such as ["Project A", "Summary"] for duplicate-heading disambiguation (fails if missing). Mutually exclusive with heading and blockId.

/properties/blockId.description: Obsidian block ID such as ^meeting-summary for block write modes (preserves the marker). Mutually exclusive with heading and headingPath.

/properties/content.description: Markdown body to write or insert (supports [[wikilinks]], #tags, callouts).

/properties/frontmatter.description: Optional top-level scalar/array YAML frontmatter keys to patch (null deletes a key). Allowed to initialize tags on create/overwrite; use manage_tags for existing notes.

/properties/idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate writes on retry.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

replace_in_note.description: Find and replace exact literal text (case-sensitive) in an existing Markdown note's body, heading section, or ^block ID while keeping YAML frontmatter intact. Requires a unique match by default; supports dryRun preview and expectedMtimeMs conflict checks. Use write_note for section rewrites or appends.

/properties/path.description: Exact vault-relative path of an existing note.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

/properties/heading.description: Optional heading scope. Mutually exclusive with headingPath and blockId.

/properties/headingPath.description: Optional full heading path such as ["Project A", "Summary"]. Mutually exclusive with heading and blockId.

/properties/blockId.description: Optional Obsidian block ID such as ^meeting-summary. Mutually exclusive with heading and headingPath.

/properties/replace.description: Replacement text; empty string deletes matched text.

/properties/replaceAll.description: Set true only when intentionally replacing every match in scope.

/properties/expectedCount.description: Optional exact match count required before writing.

/properties/dryRun.description: Set true to preview match count, scope, and mtimeMs without writing.

/properties/expectedMtimeMs.description: Optional mtimeMs from a read or preview; aborts if the note changed.

/properties/idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to reuse when retrying the same replacement.

delete_note.description: Safely move an existing Markdown note into the vault trash (.trash) instead of permanent deletion. Verifies the target, obeys vault write policies, and requires Cindy confirmation.

/properties/path.description: Vault-relative path of the existing Markdown note to move to trash.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

/properties/idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate requests on retry.

manage_tags.description: List, add, or remove YAML frontmatter tags on a single Markdown note. Matches complete tag names case-insensitively without affecting child tags, preserving the note body and other properties. Use list_tags for vault-wide tag counts.

/properties/path.description: Vault-relative path of an existing Markdown note.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

/properties/tags.description: Complete tag names required for add or remove (optional leading #; does not match child subtags).

daily_note.description: Read, initialize from template, or atomically append timestamped entries or tasks to an Obsidian Daily Note using the vault's daily-note folder, date format, and template. For targeted replacements, block edits, or frontmatter changes inside a daily note, use replace_in_note, write_note, or manage_tags on its path.

/properties/action.description: read (read-only, never creates a file), ensure (initialize if missing), append, or add-task.

/properties/date.description: Optional strict YYYY-MM-DD calendar date; defaults to today.

/properties/content.description: Entry or task text required for append or add-task.

/properties/heading.description: Optional heading section inside the daily note.

/properties/timestamp.description: Prepend HH:mm timestamp on append (default true).

/properties/idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate entries on retry.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

graph_links.description: Analyze Obsidian wikilink graph connections: inspect a note's outlinks, embeds, backlinks, unlinked mentions, and 2-hop neighbors, or find vault hubs and orphan notes. Use read_note for a note's body and direct links; use list_tags for vault-wide tags.

/properties/mode.description: Graph mode: note (default), hubs (highest-degree notes), or orphans (unlinked notes).

/properties/path.description: Exact note relative path when mode=note.

/properties/limit.description: Maximum results for hubs or orphans (1–100, default 25).

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

canvas_ops.description: List, read, create, losslessly upsert, or overwrite Obsidian .canvas boards (supports text/file/link/group nodes and preserves existing custom fields; overwrite requires confirmation).

/properties/action.description: list, read, create (fails if exists), upsert (creates if missing or merges by id), or overwrite (requires confirmation).

/properties/removeNodeIds.description: Node IDs to remove during upsert.

/properties/removeEdgeIds.description: Edge IDs to remove during upsert.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

open_in_obsidian.description: Open an existing note, Canvas board, attachment, or vault in the desktop Obsidian app on the execution computer (via Obsidian CLI or exact-path obsidian:// URI). Use open_workbench to open the visual panel inside Cindy.

/properties/path.description: Optional vault-relative file path; omit to open the vault.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

open_workbench.description: Open the interactive Obsidian Vault workbench inside Cindy to browse folders, search notes, explore backlinks, save notes via form, log Daily Notes, or configure write rules. Use open_in_obsidian to launch the desktop Obsidian app.

/properties/mode.description: Initial tab: browse, capture, or daily.

/properties/path.description: Optional exact note path to preview initially.

/properties/title.description: Optional note title to preview initially.

/properties/vault.description: Optional registered vault ID, name, or path.

complete_notes.description: App-only provider for @ composer completion returning disambiguated Obsidian note links. Models should call search_notes.

pick_vault_dir.description: Workbench only: open the system folder picker to register and select the default Obsidian vault. Models should call open_workbench.

write_receipt.description: Workbench only: check read-only whether a previous note or daily note write request was saved.

/properties/vault.description: Vault ID used by the original write request.

/properties/method.description: Original write tool name (write_note or daily_note).

/properties/idempotencyKey.description: Idempotency key of the original write request.

set_vault_write_policy.description: Workbench only: save a registered vault's read-only toggle and allowed write folders after Cindy confirmation.

/properties/readOnly.description: When true, blocks all writes and moves to trash in the vault.

/properties/restrictFolders.description: When true, allows writes only inside folders listed in folders.

/properties/folders.description: Vault-relative folder paths (including subfolders); empty list blocks all writes when restricted.

companion_folders.description: Workbench only: list local partners and their own save folders in the vault, and return the partner of the current task.

/properties/sessionId.description: Optional: the page task session ID, used to identify the current partner.

set_companion_folder.description: Workbench only: set a partner's own save folder, or pass an empty string to restore the default.

/properties/folder.description: Vault-relative folder; an empty string restores the default.

capture_reply.description: Only for the Save to Obsidian message body: save this AI reply as a new note in one step (partner conversations go to the partner's folder, other tasks to the inbox); repeating a request ID returns the note already saved.

/properties/sessionId.description: Optional: the session ID of the reply's task, used to identify the partner.

/properties/title.description: Optional: note title; defaults to the first line of the text.

/properties/vault.description: Optional: registered vault ID, name, or path.

/properties/idempotencyKey.description: Request ID that prevents duplicate saves.
